svg.title: Inspect the named practice files and review a plan in CPD Jupyter AI
svg.desc: 1: Check the practice folder and the three named files. 2: Only these named file reads were allowed once; review the plan below. 3: Check OpenCode, the CPD Qwen model and plan mode in the toolbar.
